subject: DPA: transfer impact gap list and evidence handoff - MediaCorp
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@mediacorp.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.com
Cc: legal@mediacorp.com
Date: 2028-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial DPA questions + SCCs questionnaire

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal looped me in to get the DPA and SCCs sorted so we can finalize the order form. Attached is our SCCs questionnaire and a short transfer-impact checklist — can you confirm whether Redwood can: 

- Accept controller-to-processor SCCs with the standard EU addendum?
- Provide processor role confirmation and subprocessor roster for the past 12 months?
- Confirm whether any data export exception is required for legacy analytics logs?

Also, MediaCorp legal prefers that the transfer impact addendum be explicit about encryption-at-rest key ownership and whether KMS is customer-controlled. We need answers by EOD Friday to keep procurement on track.

Appreciate it —
Sarah

Attachments: SCCs-questionnaire.pdf, Transfer-Impact-Checklist.xlsx

From: ava.chen@redwood.com <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@mediacorp.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA questions + SCCs questionnaire

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending. Looping in Karithk (privacy lead) and Ben (sales/licensing) to confirm the specifics. Quick answers up front: 

- We can sign controller-to-processor SCCs; we use the latest EU Commission standard clauses with our DPA addendum.
- We'll provide a certified subprocessor roster export (CSV) and a statement of processor roles.
- Legacy analytics logs: there is a narrow legacy export pathway; I think we'll need to flag an exception until we complete the retention purge.

Karithk / Ben — can you confirm the KMS ownership and attach the redline of Redwood's DPA we usually send (I can share our redline to speed legal review)? Sarah — if you can share MediaCorp's redline we can do a line-by-line.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@mediacorp.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA questions + SCCs questionnaire

Ava / Sarah — quick technical/legal notes from privacy: 

1) SCCs + DPA: Redwood will accept controller->processor SCCs; our standard DPA uses the Commission's 2021 clauses with an addendum that clarifies limited subprocessors and data flows. I attached our tracked DPA redline.

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_redlines_v1.docx

2) Subprocessors: We will provide the roster for the past 12 months. We also include a short attestation for each subprocessor's GDPR alignment. Expect CSV export in the next message.

3) KMS and encryption: Default hosting (Redwood-hosted KMS) uses provider-managed keys; we offer a customer-managed KMS option on Private deployments and Dedicated with an HSM integration (requires a contract amendment / order form flag). For hosted API customers the customer-managed KMS is not currently available without Private or Dedicated.

4) Legacy analytics logs: there is a retention purge scheduled week of 2028-05-21. For now we propose an interim transfer-impact addendum that:
- Flags legacy logs as "in-scope" for transfer controls;
- Commits to purge by 2028-05-28;
- Provides temporary access controls and audit log exports to MediaCorp legal upon request.

If MediaCorp needs a permanent exception, we should escalate to legal for approval; otherwise the purge plan and addendum should be fine.

Karthik
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@mediacorp.com>
Cc: ava.chen@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-12T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA questions + SCCs questionnaire

Sarah — following up with a legal/contracting proposal. We've reviewed MediaCorp's earlier order form and see two commercial asks that impact the DPA:

1) Customer-managed KMS (requested in order form) — this maps to a Private deployment feature that requires an add-on fee; we can include a note in the order form and create a Dedicated/Private addendum if you want to proceed.

2) Data localization clause around analytics logs — if you require persistent EU-only hosting for logs, we will need to schedule a short technical pilot and include an export-control exception in the DPA until the pilot completes.

I'm cc'ing Laura (Head of Sales Ops) to confirm whether we can keep E2 deployment pilot under the existing quote or need an amendment.

Propose next steps:
- Karithk to produce a short "transfer-impact addendum" draft reflecting purge timeline + interim controls.
- MediaCorp to send their DPA redline (we'll provide line-by-line comments).
- If customer-managed KMS is required, Ben/Laura to scope order form amendment and one-line charge.

I'll be available on a quick call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@mediacorp.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, ava.chen@redwood.com
Cc: legal@mediacorp.com
Date: 2028-05-13T09:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA questions + SCCs questionnaire

Thanks Ben / Karithk — attaching MediaCorp's DPA redline (v2). Main asks: explicit Customer KMS requirement (Section 8), stricter notification windows for subprocessors (10 business days), and a permanent carveout for legacy analytics (MediaCorp requires 6 months of access).

Attachment: MediaCorp_DPA_redline_v2.docx

We need Karithk's transfer-impact addendum and the subprocessor roster by EOD Thursday to keep our procurement window. If Redwood cannot offer permanent exception for legacy logs, we'll need the purge schedule and a written attestation of purge completion.

Sarah
Senior Counsel, MediaCorp

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, ava.chen@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@mediacorp.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA: transfer impact gap list and evidence handoff - MediaCorp

Team — quick summary and action plan for clarity before we hand off to legal: 

- Karithk: please finalize the transfer-impact addendum (covering purge timeline and interim access controls) and send the subprocessor roster CSV by end of day (Attachment: Transfer-Impact-Checklist.xlsx referenced).
- Ben: please prepare an order-form amendment quote for the customer-managed KMS option and indicate if this requires Dedicated/Private.
- Ava: coordinate with MediaCorp to confirm whether a 6-month legacy access window is mandatory (Sarah if you can confirm that in writing we will treat as a commercial exception).
- I'll coordinate with Legal Ops to open the redline ticket and target a final DPA signoff by 2028-05-24 if items are resolved.

Thanks all — let's use the shared Drive folder for tracked docs and keep changes minimal.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
